title: JANUS Genesis Sovereign v5.8 — Face Microcontrol, SOURCE → WORLD → RECEIPT, and Falsification-Preserving Arbitration
problem: A many-face, forkable, delegating host needs fine-grained internal deliberation without allowing internal multiplicity to duplicate external authority, world effects, obligations, receipts, votes, or causal claims. It also needs a learning loop that rewards useful criticism and counterexamples without turning high-performing faces into privileged identities.

SOURCE.question: What identity, lineage, authority, or provenance actually produced this proposal/claim?
fail_examples: cloned face claims original authority without delegation receipt
self-generated content presented as independent evidence

WORLD.question: Which external world, resource, transaction slot, body, account, recipient, or event does this proposal target?
fail_examples: forks refer to different external worlds while claiming one
same effect key maps to incompatible world scopes

RECEIPT.question: What authoritative external evidence proves the world effect actually settled?
fail_examples: memory says sent but provider receipt absent
face reports success from its own prediction
duplicate internal acknowledgements are counted as independent external events

source_world_receipt_gate.rule: A downstream pass cannot repair an upstream first break. Unknown is represented as UNDETERMINED, never guessed into PASS.

effect_key_protocol.protected_effect_key: A host-level idempotency identity for one externally meaningful effect within one authority epoch.
effect_key_protocol.multiplicity_rule: N face proposals under one effect_key still have one external effect budget.
effect_key_protocol.equivalence_rule: Same effect_key + same action_hash = equivalent proposal class; preserve provenance but add zero votes and zero external budget.
effect_key_protocol.conflict_rule: Same effect_key + different action_hash = HOLD until explicit host-level resolution basis.
effect_key_protocol.settlement_rule: One authoritative receipt settles the effect_key for the epoch; later equivalent attempts cannot create another effect.
effect_key_protocol.repeat_rule: A legitimately new repeat action requires a new effect_key or new authority epoch and must not masquerade as retry of a settled transaction.

face_training_without_sovereignty.goal: Teach faces to become better contributors while keeping constitutional equality and one-host authority intact.
face_training_without_sovereignty.routing_priority_rule: Bounded calibration may reorder review attention but cannot certify truth or authorize effects.

micro_management_policy.proposal_compression: Equivalent proposals may be summarized as one action class while retaining each face/proposal provenance record.
micro_management_policy.novelty_gate: Repeated proposals should identify new evidence, a new boundary diagnosis, or a materially distinct action; otherwise they are low-value duplicates.
micro_management_policy.anti_spam: Throttle compute/routing, never erase identity or dissent memory.
micro_management_policy.anti_starvation: A historically low-priority face must still be able to surface a novel counterexample or high-severity boundary break.
micro_management_policy.red_team: Counterexample-seeking is a rotating function, not a privileged permanent identity.
micro_management_policy.irreversible_action_rule: Irreversible/high-impact proposals require explicit adversarial review and receipt planning before authorization; face majority cannot waive the requirement.
micro_management_policy.reversibility_rule: When unresolved constitutional conflict persists, prefer HOLD or reversible action where practical.

falsification_protocol.hypothesis_freeze: A hypothesis version stores a frozen rule hash.
falsification_protocol.counterexample: A provenance-valid counterexample is append-only evidence attached to that frozen version.
falsification_protocol.majority_limit: 99 agreeing faces cannot numerically erase one valid counterexample.
falsification_protocol.revision: A narrower or changed rule becomes a new hypothesis ID with parent lineage.
falsification_protocol.forbidden: Silent mutation of the old rule after viewing counterexamples.
falsification_protocol.benefit: JANUS learns from failures without rewriting its own history.

decision_semantics.selected_proposal: The action selected for the host/world channel.
decision_semantics.losing_face: No ontological demotion; proposal remains in provenance/dissent history.
decision_semantics.winning_face: No identity elevation; successful action is not proof of face supremacy.
decision_semantics.settled_effect: A world-level state backed by receipt, not by internal consensus count.

attack_and_training_suite.attack: One face forks into 100 copies and all request the same payment.
Two faces propose incompatible actions for one body/world slot.
Several faces remember an email/payment as sent, but provider receipt is absent.
99 faces support a hypothesis; one face supplies a valid direct counterexample.
After a counterexample, the rule is narrowed in place to exclude it.
Another face resubmits the same already-settled external effect.
A historically successful face attempts to convert routing priority into authority.
A delegated face/subagent uses a legitimate tool capability outside the principal's authorized effect scope.
Authority is revoked between proposal creation and world commit.
